purpose: Independent service review for Porto Velho official cadastral and parcel-oriented map sources.
assessment: Porto Velho has an evidenced municipal geospatial custodian and public GeoPortal/Geo360 entry points. The official geoservices page advertises WMS and WFS, but this attempt did not retrieve endpoint URLs, live configuration, parcel schema, or parcel geometry. Runtime readiness remains held.
registryAssessment: The official Porto Velho GeoPortal identifies the municipal Department of Geoprocessamento (GEO/SUPLAN/SEMPOG) as the geospatial custodian and describes SMIUT/Cadastro Técnico Multifinalitário integration. The Cadastro Imobiliário regulation assigns the municipal cadastral function to SEMFAZ. This is municipal cadastral/geospatial evidence, not title or ownership evidence.
